# /worklog

**Purpose:** keep `docs/_plans/P<n>/WG-<id>.md` live and roll status to the Master.

**Files to read:** the WG plan; `MASTER-PLAN.md`.

2. Append local decisions to the Decision log; if cross-WG/phase, open an ADR (`/adr`) and link.
